problem_type: Runtime media measurement schedules durable canvas work during viewport reveal
symptom: M/media-reveal emits renderer long tasks and frame gaps when image/video nodes enter the viewport.
direct_cause: BaseGenerationNode routes onLoad/onLoadedMetadata dimension patches through updateNode defaults, bumping persistRevision and emitting a canvas event for each derived measurement.
class_root: Derived renderer observations share the user-edit mutation default because the mutation boundary has no named non-durable option set for media measurement.
affected_population: Image nodes whose result loads while mounted
Video nodes whose metadata loads while mounted
Any dense canvas reveal that mounts several media nodes
internal_only_reason: The regression is in the renderer mutation and persistence boundary; media dimensions come from the already loaded local or provider result.
invariants: Loaded media dimensions update the in-memory node so geometry remains correct.
Derived media measurement does not create an undo step, persist revision, or canvas event.
Explicit user edits retain the normal durable updateNode behavior.
generality_proof: Both image load and video metadata load converge on updateMediaDimensions and therefore receive one named option set; future media renderers can reuse the same boundary contract.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Apply measured media geometry in memory using the non-durable mutation contract.
Centralize the distinction between renderer-derived measurement and durable user mutation.

recurrence.reason: Every mounted media result can load after the canvas action and reintroduce save/event work unless the shared derived-mutation boundary remains explicit.
same_class_scan: Searched computeMediaMetaPatch callers and both media DOM load handlers.
Searched updateNode mutation options for existing non-durable renderer updates.
Checked generationCanvasStore updateNode revision and event behavior.

prevention.invariant: Renderer-derived media measurements update memory only; durable revisions/events are reserved for user or durable domain mutations.
prevention.failure_mode: The store regression test fails if the option contract stops suppressing persistence or events; the benchmark exposes long-task recurrence.
prevention.strategy: Name and reuse one immutable option set at the shared media measurement caller, then assert the store boundary behavior.

legacy_paths.rationale: No alternate media-dimension writer is retained; the ordinary durable update remains for explicit edits.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The fix is an internal renderer/store mutation contract and does not depend on a library upgrade.

migration: No project schema migration is required. Existing persisted dimensions remain readable; future loads refresh them in memory without appending durable bookkeeping.
residual_risks: A media result whose dimensions change after load is intentionally refreshed in memory and will be persisted only by a later durable edit or explicit project save.
